title: WebBrowserWidget is unable to show Intranet content due ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID via QtWebEngine
line: The Web Browser widget now offers a "Visit Anyway" button for sites with self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificates.
explanation: The widget never handled WebEngineView's certificateError signal, so QtWebEngine rejected every untrusted certificate and showed only Chromium's ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID page, with no way past it. The widget now defers overridable main-frame certificate errors and shows a placeholder message with the error's description and a "Visit Anyway" button that accepts the certificate and loads the page.

commits.message:
applets/webbrowser: offer to visit pages with untrusted certificates

The widget had no way past a certificate error, so intranet pages with
self-signed certificates could only show Chromium's error page. It now
shows the error with a "Visit Anyway" button that loads the page.

BUG: 515640

media.caption: Widget pointed at an HTTPS page with a self-signed certificate: only Chromium's error page, no way through
Same page with the fix: the widget explains the problem and offers Visit Anyway
After clicking Visit Anyway the intranet page loads
